title: 09. All Aboard the Bus
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Vroom, vroom! A big bus gently stops at the bus stop. Its doors open with a hiss, and people get on and off. Hori's eyes grow round. Wow! How can so many people fit on that bus? Vroom, vroom! Let's ride together!
Mom, where does the bus sleep, and how do we ride it? Hori asks, bouncing while holding Mom's hand. Mom smiles. Shall we visit the depot where buses rest? Kongi can come, too!

At the wide depot, matching buses rest side by side. Hello! Have you come to learn about buses? A driver in a blue uniform waves. Hori's heart goes thump, thump, with such a big bus right in front of him!

The driver points to a box beside the front steps. When you get on, tap your travel card on the reader beside the farebox. Beep! That's how you pay for your ride. Kongi almost puts in an acorn, then stops. A card, not an acorn, Kongi! Everyone laughs.

Inside the bus, round handgrips hang from the ceiling. When all the seats are full, some people stand. Hold one of these firmly so you stay steady when the bus moves. Hori holds a handgrip with both hands. Vroom, vroom! Let's ride together!

How do we tell you when we want to get off? Hori asks. The driver points to a red button beside the window. Press this stop bell, and a light tells me you want to get off at the next stop. Then I know to stop there. Hori's mouth falls open.

Shall Hori try boarding like a real passenger? Hori climbs the steps and taps his card on the reader beside the farebox. Beep! A green light shines. He stands proudly, feeling like a real bus passenger.

Holding a handgrip, Hori moves along the aisle. Now it's time to press the stop bell. Ding-dong! He presses the red button, and the stop-request light comes on. His tail stripes sparkle in rainbow colors. I know how to ride the bus, too!

The driver sits down and holds the big steering wheel. Vroom! The bus sets off to pick up passengers. Above the windscreen, a bright display shows the bus number and destination. Hori and Kongi wave. Have a safe trip!

On the way home, Hori holds Mom's hand and chats. Wait at the stop, tap the card, hold the handgrip, and ring the bell to get off! The driver carries us safely. Hori smiles at the sky. Vroom, vroom! Let's ride together!
